_meta.purpose: Machine-readable extract of the quantified, legally-worded parameters of the Résolution plan (book 'État partout, justice nulle part', Éditions Chronique, 9 Oct 2026). Every value is copied from the sources named in 'source'. Nothing here is invented; 'status' says how solid each item is. See research/source-analysis.md for context, quotes and caveats.

legal_vehicles.PLF2027_part1: data/raw/amendements/Liasse_PLF_P1.pdf (34 amendments, 19 Oct 2026, against PLF 2027 n° 3210)

status_legend.legal_text: Exact parameter written in an amendment dispositif
status_legend.site_claim: Number stated on france-resolution.fr (manifeste / fiche) with no legal text
status_legend.workbook: Number found in the Résolution xlsx workbooks
status_legend.inferred: Derived by the analyst from the above; flagged

income_tax_and_fundamental_aid.effective: IR due on 2028 incomes; monthly AFU instalments from 1 Jan 2028
income_tax_and_fundamental_aid.source: Liasse_PLF_P1 amendment 28 (article 2 PLF2027); workbook 'Synthèse Graphiques' sheets GraphIR/GraphAFU; 'Synthèse Chiffres' sheet 'Refonte fiscalité'
income_tax_and_fundamental_aid.child_age_rule: dependent child within art. 196 CGI 'jusqu'à l'année au cours de laquelle elle atteint l'âge de dix-huit ans'
income_tax_and_fundamental_aid.afu_supplement_invalidity_condition: per foyer member holding the 'carte mobilité inclusion' mention 'invalidité' (art. L.241-3 CASF)
income_tax_and_fundamental_aid.afu_supplement_pension_condition: per foyer member with a retirement pension liquidated before 1 Jan 2028; applies until IR on 2051 incomes
income_tax_and_fundamental_aid.formula: IR = 0.23 * revenu_net_imposable - AFU ; if AFU > tax the excess is paid out (negative tax)
income_tax_and_fundamental_aid.break_even_note: = 6600/0.23; amendment says 'en deçà de 28 700 € pour une personne seule'
income_tax_and_fundamental_aid.validation_cases_note: From workbook 'Synthèse Graphiques Résolution_0910.xlsx', sheet GraphIR rows 26-30 (formula in cells: =-D28*0.23; =SUM(C27:C29)). Series also given for incomes 0..72000 step 1000.

monthly_trajectory_2027.note: no rate moves in H1 2027 (set-up semester)
both contributions cease on earned income from 1 Dec 2027

csg_crdS_on_earned_income.csg_remains_on: pensions, allocations chômage, indemnités journalières (rates unchanged); capital income handled by the 30% flat levy (PLF amendment 20)
csg_crdS_on_earned_income.funded_by: all PLF savings (main) + abrogation of social-contribution exemptions (9 Md€ returned to net pay)

site_claims_to_reconcile.manifeste: 300 euros par mois restitués dès la première année, soit 13 % de salaire net en plus
site_claims_to_reconcile.fiche_travailleur: +13 % ... au salaire médian. 180 euros de plus par mois au SMIC.

employer_side_contribution_changes.exemptions_of_social_contributions_abrog: all derogations to common-law base/rate on earned income cease from 1 Jul 2027 (24 provisions abrogated) except: professional expense reimbursements (L.136-11 I al.2), affiliation/redevable/fait générateur rules, and general reductions applying to all employers without sector/purpose condition (incl. L.241-13)

phase_outs.L241-10_and_L741-16_exonerations: reduced by 1/3 from 1 Jul 2027, 2/3 from 1 Jan 2028, abrogated from 1 Jan 2029

taxe_sur_les_salaires.payers: employers not charging VAT (hospitals, clinics, banks, insurers, associations, health professions)

personal_savings_account_CEP.source: Liasse_PLF_P1 amendment 27 and 20; site fiches/manifeste; workbook 'Input Capitalisation'
personal_savings_account_CEP.effective: 1 Jan 2028; first payments due for year 2028
personal_savings_account_CEP.restitution_payment: = earned income of the year * rate fixed each year by finance law (rate is ZERO if not voted)
personal_savings_account_CEP.wealth_payment: = global amount fixed each year by finance law / number of account holders at 1 Jan (same for all; ZERO if not voted)
personal_savings_account_CEP.lock: restitution compartment (held by Caisse des dépôts) unavailable until legal pension age (art. L.161-17-2 CSS) or earlier pension liquidation, then delivered as lifetime annuity; enters the estate at death
personal_savings_account_CEP.tax_on_withdrawal: 30% flat on the taxable fraction of withdrawals, base indexed to CPI excl. tobacco; restitution payments are not taxable income
personal_savings_account_CEP.lifecycle_chart_workbook: GraphAFU: AFU 3300 (age 0-17) then 6600 (18+); compte éducation 6600/yr age 0-18; disability part 6600 age 0-63; 'part contributive de retraite' 6600 age 64+; 'rendement du patrimoine restitué' 264 €/yr all ages; 'épargne retraite personnelle' 20064 and 6600 age 64+ (meaning of 20064 not documented)

health_ceiling_bouclier_sanitaire.effective: 1 Jan 2028 and only if AFU enters into force
health_ceiling_bouclier_sanitaire.resources_definition: foyer fiscal: earned income (L.136-1-1) + replacement income (L.136-1) + cash benefits, MINUS income tax due for the year
health_ceiling_bouclier_sanitaire.floor: 5% x annual AFU amount (= 330 € if AFU = 6600)
health_ceiling_bouclier_sanitaire.covered: sum of participations (L.160-13 I,II,III) + forfait journalier (L.174-4) left to the insured within the calendar year; above the ceiling the insurer pays
health_ceiling_bouclier_sanitaire.complementary_insurers: may not cover more than half of what remains with the insured below the ceiling
health_ceiling_bouclier_sanitaire.adjustment: rate can be changed by LFSS; absent a vote it self-corrects so that health insurance spending does not increase
health_ceiling_bouclier_sanitaire.replaces: ALD (3°,4°,10° of L.160-14) for conditions recognised from 1 Jan 2028; people already recognised keep it
health_ceiling_bouclier_sanitaire.site_only: fiche patient: 'un reste à charge de 10 % par acte apparaît' (no legal text in the liasses); '300 € par an de frais de gestion en moins'

vat.reduced_5_5_and_super_reduced_2_1_to_20: 1 Jul 2028, except goods of L.213-159/L.213-166 (food, per exposé) and services leading to them: 10% from 1 Jul 2028, 15% from 1 Jul 2029, 20% from 1 Jul 2030

transfer_duties.rule: nothing below 10,000 € base; 1% on 10,000-100,000 €; 3% above 100,000 €; assessed per act and per taxpayer, base includes transfers from same person in prior 15 years; paid by the seller/heir (parties may agree otherwise); credited as acompte against the capital-gain tax
transfer_duties.today_rates_cited: 3.80% departmental (up to 4.50%) + 1.20% communal; succession rates 5%-60% by kinship
transfer_duties.abolished: departmental, communal, regional shares and all succession/donation allowances

capital_gains.replaces: 12.8%/19% IR + 17.2% social contributions (30% on securities, 36.2% on real estate)
capital_gains.real_gain: acquisition price indexed on CPI excl. tobacco; no holding-period abatements/exemptions; surtaxe >50,000 € abolished
capital_gains.effective: real estate and movables 1 Jan 2027; securities/CEP 1 Jan 2028
capital_gains.example: bought 200,000, sold 260,000, prices +10% => real gain 40,000 => tax 12,000 => 8,100 to pay after crediting 3,900

taxe_fonciere_unique.base: market rental value (INSEE tariff per m2 by category and sector, from last 3 years of rents)
taxe_fonciere_unique.note: at 10% a dwelling pays roughly today's taxe foncière incl. ordures ménagères (exposé)
taxe_fonciere_unique.default_2028_rate: local 2027 product (+ 2026 additional DMTO tax) / total market rental value, clipped to [10%,30%]
taxe_fonciere_unique.equalisation_fund: each metropolitan commune pays 2% of total rental values + 2% of product; communes ranked in 3 population-equal terciles by revenue per capita; lowest tercile receives 2/3, middle 1/3
abolished: other local land taxes listed in amendment 29 III

corporate_tax.decree_adjustment: ±2 points max when PO/GDP (INSEE last closed year) differs from 2026 level (minor if above, major if below)

unemployment_insurance.source: site fiche personne-sans-emploi; workbook 'Synthèse Chiffres' Annexe Manuscrit; PLF2 amendment 23
unemployment_insurance.after_6_months: personal account fed monthly by the unemployment contributions; unused balance stays yours
unemployment_insurance.legal_text_in_liasses: none for the 13->6 months rule or the account; only the 10% France Travail contribution is abrogated (PLF2 #23; 5.3 Md€ in régime, 1.5 Md€ in 2027)

public_employment_exit.base: gross indiciary salary of last step held in grade + share of recurring primes (decree; <= 1/4 of salary, decreasing from category C to A; zero if no decree)
public_employment_exit.stops_at: retirement age / full-rate pension entitlement / death
public_employment_exit.offers: CDI offers; 1st refusal keeps full indemnity; 2nd halves the rate; 3rd = loss

housing_aids.APL_new_claims: no right for requests filed from 1 Jun 2027; right opened by a request filed from 1 Jan 2027 is paid at most 12 months at the amount fixed at opening
housing_aids.APL_conventioned_housing_existing_rights: capped at Dec 2026 amount; -1/3 from 1 Jul 2027; -2/3 from 1 Jul 2028; ends 1 Jul 2029 or on move
housing_aids.APL_other_housing_existing_rights: ends at lease term (or loan contract) and at the latest 1 Jan 2030
housing_aids.parc_social: site: offered for sale in 3 years; net asset ~340 Md€; 4.5 M dwellings (fiche locataire)
